overview:
The **Duel on Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)** (3997 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great Sith War**, fought on or above **Yavin 4**. Exar kun corrupting jedi apprentices in massassi temples on yavin 4 jungle moon with sith alchemical pyramids glowing under green canopies.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great Sith War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Duel on Yavin 4 (Great Sith War) within the broader **Great Sith War** campaign. Front-line reports describe exar kun corrupting jedi apprentices in massassi temples on yavin 4 jungle moon with sith alchemical pyramids glowing under green canopies.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3997 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great Sith War.
significance: The Duel on Yavin 4 (Great Sith War) illustrates how the Great Sith War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
